title: Competitive Cheer Uniforms (2026)
verdict: For competitive cheer uniforms in 2026, the right maker depends on the look. Wooter is the pick for a fully sublimated competition uniform delivered in about three weeks at a published price. For rhinestones, mesh insets and couture detail, talk to Fly Athletics or Varsity Spirit.
Chassé at Omni Cheer sits in between, with competition styles and an online design studio. Custom Ink offers sublimated sets for teams on a tight budget.

ranking.fit: Gyms and school competition teams that want bold sublimated graphics, a fast turnaround and a second uniform without a second mortgage.
ranking.lacks: A sublimated line. Ask about embellishment before you plan a design around stones.

ranking.fit: All Star gyms that want couture detail such as rhinestone patterns and custom stitching.
ranking.lacks: Six to eight weeks to produce, with a minimum of six uniforms per design.

ranking.fit: All Star and school programs that want a rep-led process and Varsity's competition styles.
ranking.lacks: No public pricing or online checkout for custom uniforms. Everything runs through the rep.

ranking.fit: Squads that want in-stock shells and skirts quickly, or a sublimated set built in an online studio.
ranking.lacks: Sublimated pieces need a minimum of six and take 4 to 6 weeks.

ranking.fit: Rec and school squads that want sublimated shells, skirts and skorts with volume pricing shown upfront.
ranking.lacks: A catalog of set styles in ladies and girls cuts, recolored rather than drawn for you.

why: Competition uniforms are judged under stage lights from fifty feet away. What reads at that distance is color, contrast and a clean line, more than fine detail.
Sublimation is good at exactly that. Gradients, metallic-look prints and sharp logos are all part of the fabric, and the uniform stays light through a full-out routine.
Speed is the other argument. A gym that adds a team in October can still have uniforms from Wooter before its first competition.

criteria.name: Moves with the athlete
criteria.text: Stretch and light weight for tumbling and stunts.

criteria.name: Embellishment
criteria.text: Stones and appliqué, if the look needs them.

faq.q: How long do competition uniforms take?
faq.a: About three weeks at Wooter. Paid rush cuts that to one to two weeks. Fly Athletics quotes six to eight weeks and Omni Cheer four to six for sublimation.
No rule requires them. Plenty of teams compete in sublimated uniforms.

faq.q: Can we add athletes after the order?
faq.a: At Wooter, yes, with a minimum of one on most items. Fly Athletics also takes reorders with no minimum.

faq.q: How do we check fit before ordering?
faq.a: Order a sizing kit and fit every athlete.

faq.q: What does a competition uniform cost?
faq.a: Couture uniforms run well into three figures per athlete. Sublimated uniforms cost less. Check current prices with each maker.
